criteria.criterion: `[tool.rebar.mapping]` is registered as a reserved section and read raw via `read_reserved_section`, so its keys do not trip `_warn_unknown` even under `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error` — verified by `test_mapping_config.py::test_reserved_section_not_unknown`.

Axis maps deep-merge per key (built-in ← default ← project; unnamed key inherits) and vocabulary declarations replace wholesale (most-specific wins, not unioned) — verified by `::test_perkey_merge_precedence` and `::test_vocab_lists_replace_wholesale`.
A non-default overlay yields a different effective mapping than the built-in default through the real resolve path — verified by `::test_config_effect_contrast`.

`validate` fails closed offline with `MappingConfigError` on a value outside the effective vocabulary, a malformed block (non-mapping sub-table, non-string map value, or non-string-list vocabulary), and a capability-absent axis reference; the nearest valid config does not raise — verified by `::test_validate_fails_closed`.
The core is provider-neutral: `mapping_config` imports no `adapters.jira*` module, carrying no Jira value literal — verified by `::test_core_is_provider_neutral`.
`docs/config.md` documents the `[tool.rebar.mapping]` shape plus its three-layer merge, with a note on orthogonality to `.bridge_state/projects.json`.
